recognize_zh: CD19+ B 細胞門內的 CD5 對 CD23 流式圖：幾乎所有 B 細胞呈單一族群，CD5 弱陽性（約 10^3），CD23 陽性且強度分布廣，兩者共同表現（CD5+/CD23+）是 CLL 最典型的免疫表型。
features: Dot plot gated on CD19+ B cells: CD5-PB (x-axis) versus CD23-APC700 (y-axis)
Single dominant B-cell population coexpressing CD5 and CD23
Dim CD5 intensity (~10^3), lower than expected for T cells
CD23 positive with a broad intensity range (~10^3 to 10^5)
No separate CD5-negative/CD23-negative normal B-cell population
describe_en: Flow cytometric plot gated on CD19-positive B cells shows a single dominant population coexpressing dim CD5 and CD23, with CD23 intensity spanning a broad range. No distinct CD5-negative normal B-cell population is identified. CD5/CD23 coexpression in a monotypic B-cell population is the characteristic immunophenotype of chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and a Matutes score using CD5, CD23, FMC7, CD79b, and sIg intensity supports the diagnosis. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: MCL is CD5-positive but characteristically CD23-negative or dim, with brighter CD20/sIg and cyclin D1 expression.

ddx.dx: CD5-negative small B-cell lymphomas (MZL, FL, LPL)
ddx.vs: These lack CD5 coexpression on the clonal B cells.
Trisomy 12 CLL remains CD5/CD23-positive but more often shows brighter CD20, sIg, and FMC7, which may lower the Matutes score.
